about: Incorporated in 1994, Crystal Crop Protection is a crop solutions company with agrochemicals and seeds as its core offerings. Its portfolio includes crop protection products such as herbicides, fungicides and insecticides, along with natural crop solutions like bio-stimulants, bio-protectants, plant growth regulators, liquid fertilizers and micronutrients. It also offer seeds for field crops, vegetable crops and flowers. The offerings are customized for Indian farmers through research and development (“R&D”) including by collaborations with various multinational companies, delivering relevant solutions that aim to enhance farm economics, yield, productivity and profitability.

open.name: Mahanadi Coalfields
about: Incorporated in April 1992, Mahanadi Coalfields Limited is India’s largest coal producer in terms of production, primarily engaged in the mining and production of non-coking coal. The Company operates mainly in the Talcher and Ib Valley coalfields in Odisha and produces various grades of coal, including washed and beneficiated coal, catering primarily to the power sector as well as industries such as cement, sponge iron, steel, aluminium and paper.

The Company is a wholly owned subsidiary of Coal India Limited and was established to enhance coal production and meet India’s growing energy requirements. Its operations include a network of opencast and underground mines, supported by coal handling plants, rapid loading systems, silos and coal evacuation infrastructure. As of June 30, 2026, the Company operated 17 mines, including 14 opencast mines and three underground mines.

Mahanadi Coalfields follows a highly mechanised mining model, with extensive deployment of surface miners, enabling efficient coal extraction while reducing the use of explosives, ground vibration, dust and noise. Its predominantly opencast mining operations, mechanisation and strategic location have supported efficient production and cost management.

The Company also operates the Ib Valley Coal Washery, which has a capacity of 10 million tonnes per annum and produces washed coal with lower ash content for high-efficiency power stations. Its coal evacuation network is supported by extensive railway connectivity, dedicated coal corridors, roads, rapid loading infrastructure and access to ports on India’s eastern coast.

The Company derives a significant portion of its revenue from long-term Fuel Supply Agreements (FSAs) and serves customers across multiple states in India, including major power utilities. It is also focused on research and development, operational efficiency, technological advancement and environmentally sustainable practices, including the installation of solar power projects.

As of September 30, 2026, Mahanadi Coalfields had 20,526 permanent employees, comprising executives, workmen, staff and supervisors across mining, engineering, excavation, finance, human resources, environment, marketing and other operational functions.

Competitive Strengths: Strong financial performance and experienced management and workforce.
Well-positioned to benefit from India’s long-term demand for non-coking coal.

about: Incorporated in June 2022, Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries Limited is an integrated agro-processing company engaged in the manufacturing of Jaggery Powder, Khandsari Sugar, jaggery-based value-added food products, and sugarcane by-products. The company also operates a Cane Seed nursery, enabling backward integration in sugarcane cultivation. It serves both B2B customers through jaggery powder, Khandsari sugar, and by-products, and B2C customers through its "Feel Guddy" branded jaggery-based premix products, including Jaggery Tea, Jaggery Coffee, Instant Rice Kheer, Jaggery Laddoo, and Jaggery Lapsi.

The company follows an integrated sugarcane processing model, utilizing sugarcane to manufacture primary products while efficiently monetizing by-products such as bagasse, molasses, press mud, and ash. With backward integration into sugarcane seed cultivation, captive processing facilities, and a focus on sustainable and zero-waste manufacturing, the company has established a diversified product portfolio catering to both industrial and retail markets.
Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries emphasizes operational efficiency, quality control, sustainable manufacturing practices, and product innovation.
As of March 31, 2026, the company employed 155 permanent personnel across production, engineering, agriculture, administration, sales, finance, security, and other operational functions.

about: Incorporated in 2003, Foodlink F&B Holdings (India) Ltd. is a food and beverage services company engaged in providing premium catering services and operating casual dining restaurants and cloud kitchens. Headquartered in Mumbai, Foodlink caters to weddings, social celebrations, corporate events and other large-scale gatherings. Its restaurant portfolio includes brands such as China Bistro, India Bistro, Glocal and Art of Dum. The company also operates through its international subsidiary in the UAE, expanding its presence in the global food and hospitality industry.

Business Model: Banquets and Integrated F&B Services (Jade Luxury Banquets).
